authorization.request: 优化 DSH Store 网站 SEO/GEO；用户明确更正目标站点为 DSH Store。

objective: Ensure core DSH STORE discovery pages serve locale-consistent titles, descriptions, social previews, page-level structured data, and first-fold copy in static HTML before JavaScript runs.

changes.behavior: Generate Chinese or English title, meta description, Open Graph, Twitter, page-level JSON-LD name and description, and key first-fold text from the site's canonical locale during the static build. Add a WebPage schema where a core page has none. Keep JavaScript language switching and page routing intact.
nonGoals: No Catalog, DSH package, Profile, or lifecycle changes.
No Google Search Console, Bing, Baidu, or IndexNow account mutation.
No production server or DNS change.
No claim that indexing, ranking, visits, or AI citations have improved without their own measurement evidence.

deterministicGates: Recheck base Commit and every listed precondition hash immediately before editing and before commit.
git diff --check passes and the changed-file set is exactly the declared scope.
npm run check passes using the repository's disposable fixtures.

Build international and domestic output into disposable directories; verify language, title, description, social metadata, page-level JSON-LD, first-fold copy, canonical URLs, hreflang, and sitemap host for both origins.
Keep every title and meta description within the locale-specific deterministic length bounds enforced by the static-build test.
Submit one auditable CI-checked pull request; production deployment and public indexing are separate states.
healthCheck: International output exposes English core SEO metadata, matching page-level structured data, and first-fold headings before JavaScript; domestic output exposes Simplified Chinese equivalents. Existing canonical and hreflang links remain correct, and no DSH/Profile mutation occurs.

rollback.source: Revert the exact merged SEO-content commit through a new CI-checked pull request.
rollback.runtime: No runtime, server, DSH package, Catalog, or Profile state is changed by this plan.
